plan.rationale: Router authorized a provisional merge of K5_C0001 and K5_C0005 for re-review. Boundary-structure evidence is merge-compatible: near-zero independent two-way spectral ARI (0.044), high normalized-cut cost (0.904), within-side affinity (0.394) only modestly exceeding between-side affinity (0.230), and a union dominated by the single-cluster resolution (candidate_k=1, leading eigengap 0.733). Boundary-representation evidence is conflicting across modalities (WSI silhouette 0.393 vs CT 0.029, RNA 0.040, WXS 0.023), and K5_C0005 is very small (4 members), so its geometry is unstable. Biological phenotypes differ (K5_C0001 OXPHOS-down/TGF-beta/WNT vs K5_C0005 E2F/MYC/G2M proliferation), which opposes but does not mechanically preclude a provisional merge. This plan executes only the Router's authorized action and returns the union for normal review; it is not acceptance or final subtype assignment.

The current boundary shows substantial agreement with an independent two-way spectral partition (ARI ~0.69) and within-side affinity exceeding between-side affinity, which supports partial representation of the present two-way assignment. However, the normalized-cut cost (0.537) is moderate-to-high, reflecting appreciable cross-boundary connectivity and weaker graph separation of the current sides. Taken together, this is conflicting structural evidence: a partially represented current boundary coexisting with a single-cluster-dominated union. This report does not recommend accept, drop, split, or merge.
